blocks.text: BERLIN IS SENDING YOU|TO AMERICA. YOU WILL|BUILD A NETWORK THERE.
THE QUESTIONNAIRE FIT INSIDE|A PUNCTUATION MARK. IT WAS|CALLED A MICRODOT.
A WHOLE PAGE WAS ABOUT|A SINGLE ISLAND, ON THE|OTHER SIDE OF THE WORLD.
BERLIN HAD NO FLEET IN THE PACIFIC.|SO WHO WAS IT ASKING THESE QUESTIONS FOR?
